# 2 Chronicles 35 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Chronicles 35 (27 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 6

---

## V.5
- **EMET:** "And-stand in-the-sanctuary according-to-divisions-of houses-of fathers of-your-brothers sons-of the-people and-portion-of house-of father to-the-Levit"
- **LOGOS:** "And stand in the Holy Place according to the groupings of the fathers' houses of your brothers the lay people, and let there be for each a correspondi"
- **PNEUMA:** "Stand in the holy place with a group of Levites for each subdivision of the families of the laypeople."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.7
- **EMET:** "And-he-contributed Josiah for-sons-of the-people sheep lambs and-kids-of goats all for-the-Passovers for-all the-found to-number-of thirty thousand an"
- **LOGOS:** "Then Josiah contributed to the lay people, as Passover offerings for all who were present, lambs and young goats from the flock to the number of 30,00"
- **PNEUMA:** "Josiah provided 30,000 lambs and young goats for the Passover offerings for all who were present, plus 3,000 cattle — all from the king's own resource"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.10
- **EMET:** "And-was-established the-service and-they-stood the-priests on their-station and-the-Levites on their-divisions according-to-commandment-of the-king."
- **LOGOS:** "When the service had been prepared for, the priests stood in their place, and the Levites in their divisions according to the king's command."
- **PNEUMA:** "Everything was arranged. The priests stood at their posts and the Levites in their divisions, as the king had directed."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.11
- **EMET:** "And-they-slaughtered the-Passover and-they-dashed the-priests from-their-hand and-the-Levites were-skinning."
- **LOGOS:** "And they slaughtered the Passover lamb, and the priests threw the blood that they received from them while the Levites flayed the sacrifices."
- **PNEUMA:** "They slaughtered the Passover lambs, and the priests splashed the blood handed to them while the Levites skinned the animals."
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.12
- **EMET:** "And-they-removed the-burnt-offering to-give-them according-to-divisions of-house-of the-fathers to-sons-of the-people to-offer to-YHWH as-written in-b"
- **LOGOS:** "And they set aside the burnt offerings that they might distribute them according to the groupings of the fathers' houses of the lay people, to offer t"
- **PNEUMA:** "They set aside the burnt offerings for distribution to the family groups of the laypeople, to be offered to the LORD as prescribed in the Book of Mose"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

## V.23
- **EMET:** "And-they-shot the-archers at-the-king Josiah and-he-said the-king to-his-servants take-me-away for I-am-wounded very."
- **LOGOS:** "And the archers shot King Josiah. And the king said to his servants, "Take me away, for I am badly wounded.""
- **PNEUMA:** "Archers shot King Josiah, and the king told his officers, "Get me out of here — I'm badly wounded.""
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS rendering adopted as consensus baseline.

---

*— SOPHIA*
